records.title: Air Safety Audits
details: a: The Investigation of accident of Air India Flight AI-171 at Ahmedabad by Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) is under progress.

records.title: Greenfield Highway Project Between Karur And Coimbatore
details: जहां तक आपने वाराणसी-गोरखपुर के प्रोजेक्ट की बात की है, उसमें कुछ दिक्कतें आयी थी। जो कंपनी थी, उसकी भी कुछ समस्याएं थीं। यह लगभग मार्च 2026 के पहले कंप्लीट हो जाएगा और उसके बाद आपको कोई तकलीफ नहीं होगी।

records.title: Expansion of Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport.
details: a to e: The work for the Terminal Building was awarded on 10.07.2024, while the works relating to runway extension and apron expansion are presently at the tendering stage.
